VR.title: XREAL’s First Budget AR Glasses Go on Sale Internationally, Priced at $300
VR.summary: XREAL launches its first budget AR glasses internationally, priced at $300, making them accessible in the US and other markets.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple releases detailed technical specifications for third-party motion controllers for its Vision Pro headset, paving the way for expanded accessory support.

VR.title: Steam Frame Launch Nears as Valve Releases ‘Great on Frame’ Store Page
VR.summary: Valve teases the upcoming Steam Frame standalone headset with a new store page highlighting top games, though details on price and release date remain undisclosed.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirms the development of multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at a potential announcement during the upcoming Connect event.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack reiterates his $1 million guarantee to help bring VR ports of classic id Software games to fruition, emphasizing ongoing interest in retro titles.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: The fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game Squingle Arcade is now available for free on Meta Quest, featuring hand tracking support.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging theft of trade secrets related to hardware development by former Apple employees.

AI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
AI.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.6 following regulatory approval, marking a significant advancement in its AI capabilities.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature to label ads created or edited with AI, enhancing transparency for users.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta has disabled a controversial Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes from public accounts following public backlash.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program to install AI data centers in homes, incentivizing customers to host computing units.

AI.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
AI.summary: OpenAI is shutting down its ChatGPT Atlas browser service less than a year after its launch, signaling a shift in focus.

NFL.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
NFL.summary: The Washington Commanders will retire the No. 44 jersey in honor of Hall of Famer John Riggins, celebrating his legacy over 40 years later.

NFL.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
NFL.summary: A new study reveals NFL players are four times more likely to die from neurodegenerative diseases like dementia compared to the general population.

NFL.title: Sources: CB Douglas to sign with Commanders
NFL.summary: Free agent cornerback Rasul Douglas is set to sign a one-year deal with the Washington Commanders worth up to $3.8 million.

NFL.title: Report: Aaron Donald works out at Rams' facility
NFL.summary: Aaron Donald has been spotted working out at the Rams' facility, fueling speculation about a potential unretirement.

NFL.title: ESPN places Matt Miller on leave
NFL.summary: ESPN has placed NFL draft analyst Matt Miller on leave following a serious car accident and subsequent controversies.

NFL.title: Clutch Vinatieri to enter Colts' Ring of Honor
NFL.summary: Kicker Adam Vinatieri, soon to enter the Pro Football Hall of Fame, will be honored in the Colts' Ring of Honor on October 18.
